snippet.title: Elandrake - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Demo Launch Trailer for my project Elandrake!

Elandrake is an incremental, twin-stick shooter where you protect a cosmic entity as it emerges from another reality. Consume matter to gain abilities and use them to blast fleets back to where they came from! 


Play The Demo Now  -https://store.steampowered.com/app/4992600/Elandrake

Follow On X: https://x.com/i2_Games
Join the Discord: discord.gg/ewjJqVf
